statement_en: If a function $f:[x,y]\to\mathbb{R}$ is monotone, then its sum over integers can be estimated by an integral in the quantitative form $$\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}:y\leq n\leq x} f(n)=\int_y^x f(t)\,dt+O(|f(x)|+|f(y)|).$$
callout_body: 如果函数$f:[x,y]\to\mathbb{R}$是单调函数那么求和可以被积分估计(量化版本的):$$\sum_{n\in{\mathbb{Z}}:y\leq n\leq x}f(n)=\int_{y}^{x}f(t)\,dt+O(|f(x)|+|f(y)|)$$
